propositions: Project code-review criteria with non-empty applies_to are never gated against changed files during dispatch, running unconditionally on all reviews
The applies_to field is stored in overlay but never validated for shape or read by any code-review dispatch path, whereas plan-review validates and uses applies_to equivalently
A malformed applies_to value (bare string, non-list, non-string element) silently fails to narrow the criterion matching, leaving it always-on without error
The dispatch path must thread changed_files through _activated_code_review_project_criteria and match project criteria globs against them, mirroring the triggers step behavior
An empty or absent applies_to on a project criterion must remain always-on, whereas non-empty applies_to must be validated and glob-matched against the review's changed files
